purpose: The one over-bound month-B Audiences delivery the deploy-gated tests/integration/test_d2_audiences_over_bound_acceptance.py accepts as over_bound_source. A validation-only generator builds it at the D2 live-acceptance step and lands it as a probe-owned delivery; it is not in the generated fixture corpus, needs no src/ or land_fixtures/bundle.py change, and normal dev landing never lands it.
month: the profile month after the month A the Audiences CURRENT pointer serves when the acceptance starts
row_floor_basis: audiences_row_budget(1) + 1: one more profile and campaign row than one Audiences body carries
